blockers: The internal HiBob API is not a supported public integration contract. Live overwrite, interactive SSO, temporary-tab fallback and an uninterrupted native run exceeding five minutes without DevTools have not received native acceptance.
validationEvidence: Automated unit, API-ledger and browser tests cover ownership, realistic save responses, weekly targets, checkpoints, retained-entry reconciliation and failure recovery.

Native Chrome acceptance covers existing-session/direct connection, complete month read, current and future creation, verification checkpoints and independent saved-data reconciliation. Private acceptance reports and personal attendance data are kept outside Git.
